explanation: Matches the second question: there is a graph with no uncountable clique such that every ℕ-colouring of its edges has an infinite monochromatic clique. 'No K_{ℵ₁}' is encoded as all cliques countable, and a monochromatic K_{ℵ₀} as an infinite clique with constant colour on distinct pairs. It is open in ZFC and stated affirmatively.
